revision_summary: Three timestamp errors need correction in script_coverage: (1) the bill_collection customer quote 'I just sent it to you.' is mislabeled at ts 03:40 — it actually occurs at 06:49 (03:40 is the rep's bill-ask line); (2) the appointment_set rep quote about '9:30 AM or 12PM tomorrow' is mislabeled at ts 07:03 — it actually starts around 07:17-07:26 (07:03 is the rep asking about morning/afternoon/evening preference); (3) the appointment_set customer quote '12PM would would work.' is mislabeled at ts 07:03 — it actually occurs at 07:28. Fix all three timestamps to match actual transcript positions. Additionally: relabel the script_coverage section currently called 'tax_credit_qualifier' to 'credit_qualifier' or similar, since it covers the credit score threshold question, not a tax credit disclosure, and its current name misleadingly implies a different schema section. Also add a missed-moment entry (or fold into handoff_brief.unresolved_concerns) covering the customer's uncertainty about having a separate/own power meter (00:51-01:26) — a townhouse-specific hard qualifier that was never firmly resolved before the rep moved on ('you should be golden then' despite the customer's hedged 'probably yes... I don't know'). This should be flagged for the closer to verify on-site. Minor: soften 'exact_promises_rep_made' framing around financing/incentives — rep set an expectation ('they'll go over the options') rather than making a hard promise; relabel as expectation rather than promise for accuracy.
